credentials.protected_value_authority: GitHub staging Environment secret store backed by externally issued Cloudflare API token
credentials.legitimate_mutable_authority: external Cloudflare token issuance plus write-only GitHub staging Environment binding ceremony
credentials.exposure_boundary: Accepted-main protected staging observation/preflight/post-verify, protected D1 identity/ledger/recovery-metadata reads and hosted readiness/Core-disablement audit jobs only; pull_request, production and provider-mutation exposure are forbidden.
credentials.resource_scope: exact staging Cloudflare account referenced by CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOY_MANIFEST_JSON; no production account or zone scope

required_read_calls: Wrangler D1 SELECT-only remote migration ledger read

credentials.rotation_recovery_policy: Issue a new exact-scope read-only token externally, capture metadata-only policy attestation bound to its token id, bind it write-only to staging, require accepted-main runtime verification, then revoke the previous token. On any mismatch keep mutation blocked and restore/reissue a known-good read-only token; never widen permissions as recovery.
metadata_evidence: accepted-main required read-call outcomes including disabled Core mailbox hosted-surface observations

ephemeral_runtime_credential_extensions.rationale: AR-11 permits the ephemeral platform-issued github.token to receive Actions:write only inside the accepted-main GitHub Governance Hosted State job, solely to disable exact registration IDs classified by checked-in retirement evidence. Pull-request execution remains read-only, unknown registrations remain fail-closed, run history is preserved, and this authority cannot mutate Cloudflare or production.

existing_credential_extensions.rationale: AR-11 retains the accepted AR-8B GitHub admin credential identity while activating its protected hosted-governance reconciliation consumer; no pull_request exposure or new mutable credential authority is introduced.

AR-11 permits the existing deploy-capable Cloudflare platform credential only in the canonical staging provider-mutation jobs after credential-free/native policy and exact-current fences. Hosted governance/readiness and D1 observation use the separate read-only observe credential. Production mutation remains unauthorized.
AR-11 Release Set promotion and hosted readiness consume the accepted protected deployment manifest without changing its value authority or staging/production scope.
AR-11 Release Set post-deploy verification reuses the accepted Cloudflare Access service-auth pair inside the existing protected staging/production environment boundary.
